name: kxtrumpapprove
title: Trump's RCP approval average on Oct 8, 2026?
settlement: If Trump's RCP approval average is below 38.2% at exactly 1:00 PM ET on Oct 8, 2026, the market resolves Yes. The resolution source is the 'Approve' value in the 'RCP Average' row of the RealClearPolitics 'President Trump Job Approval' table.
decideContext: Estimate the effect of the news item on Trump's RealClearPolitics (RCP) average approval rating percentage, which is an average of recent national polls, as it will read on Oct 8, 2026.
